dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ yào yī zhāng shǒujīkǎ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.reading: Hǎo de. Nǐ yào duōshao liúliàng?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 我每天都上网，要很多流量。
dialogue.reading: Wǒ měitiān dōu shàngwǎng, yào hěn duō liúliàng.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: 这张卡一个月一百块，流量很多。
dialogue.reading: Zhè zhāng kǎ yī ge yuè yībǎi kuài, liúliàng hěn duō.
